```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source("00_functions.R")

load("Data/12_DataSaving.RData")
```

# 1 Data Processing

```{r}
# Ace diff for all matches
tennis_clean$ace_difference <- calculate_ace_difference(tennis_clean)

# Ace diff for each court surface
tennis_grass$ace_difference <- calculate_ace_difference(tennis_grass)
tennis_clay$ace_difference <- calculate_ace_difference(tennis_clay)
tennis_hard$ace_difference <- calculate_ace_difference(tennis_hard)

# test first 6
head(tennis_clean)
head(tennis_grass)
head(tennis_clay)
head(tennis_hard)
```
```{r}
# Summary
summary(tennis_clean$ace_difference)

summary(tennis_grass$ace_difference)
summary(tennis_clay$ace_difference)
summary(tennis_hard$ace_difference)
```
```{r}
# Save processed datasets
save(
  tennis_clean,
  tennis_grass,
  tennis_clay,
  tennis_hard,
  file = "Data/22_DataSaving.RData"
)
```
